summary: The proposed patch addresses the specific issue but may not handle all edge cases and introduces additional complexity.

issues.description: The patch specifically handles the case where the set contains imaginary components and intersects with Reals. However, it may not cover all possible edge cases involving complex expressions and intersections with Reals.
The added code is somewhat complex and could be made more readable. It also assumes that the set is defined using a Lambda function with a single argument, which might not always be the case.
